versions.changelog:
Initial release of Pillow Buying Consultant — helps users determine their ideal pillow specs with brand-neutral, region-aware guidance.

- Guides users through targeted questions about sleep style, body proportions, fill preferences, and sensitivities.
- Provides clear, structured pillow specification recommendations (loft, firmness, fill type, size).
- Makes purchasing advice fully brand-neutral to empower independent selection.
- Adjusts recommendations based on user’s region and local product availability.
- Designed for new buyers or those unsure of pillow specs/terminology.
